sentences.japanese: 大気の質は過去数年において悪化した。
sentences.english: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.

sentences.japanese: 一般的に、消費者は質よりも量を選ぶ。
sentences.english: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.

sentences.japanese: その夕食は彼が今夜食べた夕食より質が良かった。
sentences.english: The dinner was superior in quality to the one he ate this evening.

sentences.japanese: これらの品物は質よりも量でまさっている。
sentences.english: These goods are greater in quantity than in quality.

sentences.japanese: この布はあれよりも質がいいですよ。
sentences.english: This cloth is superior to that.
